status: pre-implementation diagnostic protocol; no runtime adoption
cases: all 40 unchanged supplied question occurrences; known development cases, not held out

arms.A: Exact current literal-token IDF ranking; validate candidate order against approved engine.
arms.B0: Same ranking plus label/alias tokens from already resolved declared concepts. Original query terms weight2; expansion terms weight1; no new aliases or profiles.

expansion_order: Distinct eligible extra tokens sorted by canonical lexical order, limited to remaining query-token capacity. Each token retains declaring concept IDs.
measures: Per-case candidate-location overlap with the earlier incomplete source-candidate register, explicitly not relevance or answer accuracy.
Top16 whole-source bytes and candidate identity changes.
Exact-baseline agreement with actual pinned engine candidate order.
boundaries: No new source, summary generation, provider call or live engine change.
No wrong-heading metadata is used. This isolates terminology before structural/summary card experiments.
Source-candidate locations are incomplete review leads, not an exhaustive correct-answer set.
Retain every case, regressions and null outcomes. No thresholds or weights tuned after observing results.
No claim of full-unit dependency closure or answerability from ranking alone.
